title: Fractales — AI Tool Definitions
description: MCP and OpenAI-function-calling compatible tool definitions for the Fractales fractal explorer. All tools operate on static GitHub Pages resources — no server required.

tools.name: list_fractals
tools.description: Return the complete catalogue of all fractals available in the viewer. Each entry includes the fractal identifier, human-readable label, mathematical description, family, render mode, source module, default view preset, and a ready-to-use deep link. Use this as the first step to discover what is available before selecting a specific fractal.

failure_cases.action: Use cached data or report unavailability to the user

tools.name: get_fractal
tools.description: Retrieve full metadata for a single fractal by its identifier. Returns the same structure as one entry from list_fractals, including render mode, source URL, default view preset, and deep link. Prefer this over list_fractals when you already know the fractal identifier.

fractal_id.description: Fractal identifier in snake_case, e.g. 'mandelbrot', 'julia', 'barnsley', 'koch'. Use list_fractals to discover valid identifiers.

endpoint.note: Fetch the full catalog and filter client-side by id == fractal_id

examples.description: Get metadata for the Barnsley fern

response_shape.label: Barnsley
response_shape.description: Barnsley fern: iterated function system (IFS) botanical fractal.

failure_cases.action: Return null; call list_fractals to enumerate valid identifiers

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: Return the index of fractal families. Each family groups fractals by mathematical type: evasion (escape-time), formule (free-form formula variants), dynamique (dynamic systems and attractors), ifs (iterated function systems), lsystem (L-system curves), magnetique (magnetic renormalization), lisse (smooth coloring variants), orbitrap (orbit trap coloring), distance (distance estimation), classe (OOP compatibility demo). Use this to let users browse by mathematical category.

tools.name: get_family
tools.description: Return the full fractal list for a specific family, including complete metadata for each member. Valid family identifiers: evasion, formule, dynamique, ifs, lsystem, magnetique, lisse, orbitrap, distance, classe.

family_id.description: Family identifier. Use list_families to discover available families and their descriptions.

failure_cases.action: HTTP 404; use list_families to enumerate valid identifiers

tools.name: construct_deeplink
tools.description: Construct a deep link URL that opens the fractal viewer at a specific location, zoom level, rotation, and palette. No HTTP request is needed — the URL is assembled from the parameters. The viewer uses URL hash fragments so the link is shareable and bookmark-able. pixelSize controls zoom: smaller values zoom in (e.g. 1e-6 for deep zoom, 4e-3 for default). rotation is in radians (0 to 2π).

centerX.description: Center X coordinate in the complex plane (real axis)

centerY.description: Center Y coordinate in the complex plane (imaginary axis)

pixelSize.description: Units of the complex plane per pixel. Controls zoom level. Default ~4e-3 (full view). Use 1e-6 or smaller for deep zoom.

rotation.description: Rotation angle in radians (0 to 2π). Default: 0.

maxIter.description: Maximum iterations for escape-time computation. Higher values reveal more detail but are slower. Default: 256.

juliaCre.description: Optional Julia-family parameter c real part, encoded as jr.

juliaCim.description: Optional Julia-family parameter c imaginary part, encoded as ji.

coloringMode.description: Optional Palette Physics coloring mode, encoded as cm.

palettePhase.description: Optional palette phase, encoded as ph.

lsystemLineColor.description: Optional L-system line coloring mode, encoded as lc.

lsystemStrokeWidth.description: Optional L-system proposal stroke width, encoded as lsw.

weatherOverlays.description: Optional comma-separated mathematical weather overlays, encoded as ov. Supported values: grille, contours, orbite.

lsystemProposal.description: Optional applied Atelier L-system proposal. Encoded as lp/lg/la/lax/lr/ls and rendered temporarily through the line-fractal pipeline without adding an official catalogue fractal. Rules may use deterministic weighted stochastic alternatives such as F=0.5:FF|0.5:F[+F].

formulaProposal.description: Optional applied Atelier formula proposal. Encoded as fpa/ffi/ffe/ffm/ffa/ffb and rendered temporarily through the scalar escape-time pipeline without adding an official catalogue fractal.

endpoint.note: Assemble directly from parameters — no HTTP request required

examples.description: Deep zoom into the Mandelbrot seahorse valley

failure_cases.action: Reject: pixelSize must be strictly positive
The viewer will fall back to Mandelbrot; validate against list_fractals first
The viewer will use aurora; validate against list_palettes first

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Retrieve the source code of the fractal implementation. Source is written in the multilingual programming language (French-syntax language that compiles to WebAssembly). A transpiled Python version is also available. The source reveals the exact mathematical iteration used.

fractal_id.description: Fractal identifier. Use get_fractal to find the source module name.

language.description: Source language. 'multilingual' returns the French-syntax .multi source; 'python' returns the transpiled Python equivalent.

endpoint.note: First call get_fractal to resolve fractal_id → source.module, then fetch the file

examples.description: Fetch Barnsley fern source in Python

failure_cases.action: The fractal may use a bundled module; check source.url field in the fractal entry

tools.name: get_benchmark
tools.description: Return the WebAssembly vs Python benchmark results measured during the last build. Includes execution time in milliseconds for both runtimes and the speedup factor. Useful for demonstrating the performance advantage of the multilingual → WASM compilation pipeline.

failure_cases.action: Benchmark was not completed during this build; values are unavailable

tools.name: list_palettes
tools.description: Return the list of available color palettes, palette physics coloring modes, and descriptions. Pass the palette identifier to construct_deeplink or include it in a viewer URL fragment as p={palette_id}.

palettes.description: Synthwave aurora — electric void → neon teal → acid lime → gold. Default.
Volcanic plasma — char-black → electric crimson → acid yellow → white-hot.

tools.name: list_exploration_modes
tools.description: Return the advanced non-AI exploration modes exposed by the viewer: parameter maps, journey keyframes, palette physics, deep zoom, 3D studio controls, L-system proposal workbench, formula workbench, and mathematical weather overlays. Includes the URL hash fields used to preserve mode state in shareable links.
